excerpts.text: - [x] Primitive wrappers: required checked owner holds six declarations for wrapper creation, foreign-eval normalization, ToObject, brand checks, string receiver unwrapping and default-hint conversion; eight emission boundaries use explicit dependencies. Merged in #1679 after CI gates and exact-head review completed. The external review reported no actionable findings. Its initial full-source review lacked clone-backed analysis; the subsequent one-file allocation-test review completed on the final head without reporting that limitation. Immutable-head source audits and local supplemental reviews passed. Local verification includes 756 distinct passing regressions (34 new component and 18 isolated cases), 21 IL-verified comparisons preserving all 22,380 method bodies/exception regions, 19 exact executions including runtime-present eval and two hosted assemblies. Four red/green cases prove optional BigInt/Date metadata controls scoped emission independently of opposite feature selection. Three early declaration stages, wrapper identities, String exotic descriptors, hooks and guest errors remain unchanged. The original boxed Number string-hook behavior and async Number lookup limitation are preserved; the suspension probe creates the wrapper before entering the async function. Normal loopback access was used for network fixtures. A subsequent test-only CI correction retains the 4,096-byte numeric bitwise allocation limit while using the existing five-sample helper; fresh build and 46 targeted tests passed, including persistent-allocation controls for both budgets. Compiler code remained unchanged from the 756-case verification. Number/Boolean prototypes and all broader residual ownership work remain in scope.

- [x] General numeric coercion: required `EmittedNumericCoercionRuntime` owns five conversion declarations with checked access, repairable initialization and validated completion. Merged in #1685 after all CI/Desktop gates and exact-head 55-file review passed with no actionable findings. Five emitter boundaries take the owner and exact immutable conversion, descriptor, invocation and error inputs. All 179 bound references migrate, including conditional reads, while early RegExp declarations, the required BigInt adapter, native signatures/inlining and per-assembly indirect function lookup remain unchanged. All 2,623 broader regression cases and 38 new cases passed (20 owner/staging/selection/hosting/native/cache/reuse, 18 isolated outputs). Twenty saved assemblies pass IL verification and preserve normalized metadata, imports, constants and 20,679 method bodies/exception regions, with 18 exact executions and two hosted outputs. Source audit preserves six complete bodies, surrounding scoped files, full orchestration and 46 other consumer files after equivalent substitutions; Release and code-quality checks pass. Final CI passed 21,687 core tests plus 1 existing platform skip on Linux and 21,685 core tests plus 3 existing platform skips on Windows, plus 129 GUI tests per platform and zero failures. All 38 new cases and unchanged generator, fork IPC and lifecycle controls passed on both platforms. Existing explicit Number exotic-hook and CommonJS alias behavior remains preserved. No CI limits, test assertions or performance budgets changed in this phase; JSON reuse and the complete remaining ownership/audit scope remain required.
